description: Negotiate your hourly rate for a 3-month freelance engagement with a time-pressured client who has a fixed budget.

user_brief.context: Your standard rate is $120/hr. You have another client who would pay $90/hr as a fallback. The project is a 3-month full-stack build — roughly 400 hours.

opponent_hidden.persona: Direct and time-pressured. Has a fixed project budget approved by stakeholders. Anchors aggressively on day one. Will invoke deadline pressure to force concessions.
opponent_hidden.urgency: High — project kick-off is in 2 weeks and the client needs to sign a contract this week or risk missing the launch window.
